messages:
Nadia: tiny photo dump 10 Sparrow (our office hedgehog) built a campsite out of a tissue box and my old hoodie. tent-cam attached. https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F55555/sparrow_camp.jpg :camping: :hedgehog:

Sam: this is peak indie camping. does Sparrow have a little marshmallow on a toothpick? :marshmallow:

Nadia: not a marshmallow, but a tiny felt s'more someone knitted last week. posted a slow-boop gif of Sparrow inspecting it. 0:03 he attempted to roll the s'more. adorable chaos.

Eli: he looks like a tiny park ranger on break. new job title: "Head of Small Wilderness".

Tara: Facilities note: please keep the tent setup on the side table, away from the plant lights. we don't want overheating. Facilities will add a "pet staging" label. FacilitiesBot please confirm? :thermometer:

FacilitiesBot: Acknowledged: pet staging noted. Keep fabric away from hot lamps. Reminder: no open flames near animals.

Sam: poll 1 1 If Sparrow had a campsite name, pick one: 1) The Cozy Quill 2) Tiny Pines 3) Hoodie Hollow 4) S'more Springs

Eli: `/:one:` The Cozy Quill, obvious winner.

Tara: `/:three:` Hoodie Hollow gets my vote. very on brand.

Nadia: `/:four:` S'more Springs because he likes the felt snack.

PollBot: Poll created: "Name Sparrow's campsite" Options: The Cozy Quill / Tiny Pines / Hoodie Hollow / S'more Springs 1 Current: The Cozy Quill 1, Tiny Pines 0, Hoodie Hollow 1, S'more Springs 1

Eli: bonus idea 1 can we make a tiny guestbook post-it people can sign when they visit the camp? low effort, high morale.

Sam: bringing a mini flag tomorrow. also planning to knit a teeny headlamp (no real light).

Nadia: thanks y'all! will keep the tent-cam running for lunch peek-ins and post the slow-mo roll if he does it again. closing note: Sparrow snores like a tiny zipper. :zipper_mouth_face:
